We report ROUGE F-scores that compares the overlap between generated text with gold summaries. For SPACE dataset, we measure how much general summaries cover different aspects by computing the mean ROUGE-L score with the gold aspect summaries (denoted by RL ASP). We also compute perplexity (PPL) score to evaluate the readability of summaries.
